messages:
maya: Quick design check — updated 'Privacy Flags' panel mock in Figma. Reordered CTAs (Save left, Revert right) and added a small KMS badge. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123
sam: Saw it — quick thought: Save left feels counter to other console pages where primary is right. Do we have a firm pattern?
kevin: Agreed w/ Sam. We standardize primary to right across settings pages. If we change here, need pattern doc update.
maya: We discussed before to put destructive or network-affecting actions on left to avoid accidental clicks. This is more like 'apply policy' though non-destructive.
leah: Accessibility nit: keyboard focus jumps from retention slider to region picker, but the KMS badge is only visible visually — screen readers skip it. We need aria-describedby for the badge.
sam: +1. Proposed aria: ```aria-describedby="kms-desc-<key>"``` and a hidden text node: "Key managed by customer's KMS — affects export and rotation policies".
kevin: Copy NIT on tooltip: current tooltip says "Encrypt w/ KMS". Please expand to "Encrypt with customer-managed key (KMS)" and add link to docs.
maya: For audit log entries, product wants the event to read: "Retention policy changed" vs current "retention.update" — prefer human text.
leah: Also timestamps: audit log shows epoch-like ISO but hides timezone. Make it "Mar 12, 2026 14:32 UTC" instead of "2026-03-12T14:32:00Z" for readability.
sam: UX question: region dropdown order — should it be prioritized by user's org region first, then alphabetical? We discussed geo-fallback earlier.
kevin: Yes, prefer org-region, then recent choices, then alphabetical. Also add aria-label="Region" on the select.
maya: Visual: KMS badge contrast fails WCAG 2.1 AA on small screens. Need darker border or bg. Screenshot: https://img.internal/klm.png
leah: Small copy tweak for retention presets: "30 days (default)" -> "30 days — recommended for PII-light workloads" (2 variants?) Maybe too long.
sam: Keep presets concise. Use hover tooltip for extra guidance.
kevin: Action items:
- maya: update figma to put primary button right and show both variants (primary right vs left) — due EOD
- leah: add aria-describedby text and verify in VoiceOver — due tomorrow
- sam: write audit log copy proposals and timestamp formatting PR — due Thu
- kevin: run contrast check and propose color tokens
maya: I'll also update KMS tooltip copy and add docs link.
leah: OK to ship the non-critical copy changes with a follow-up a11y patch? :eyes:
sam: fine as long as nothing blocks screen reader flow.
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll post updated screenshots when ready.
